Why do we ask for a video?
Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you . Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

• How you communicate and connect with people.

title: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) - Springfield, MA
description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70 K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

• Inclusive, socially responsible, cl

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
About Blue Water Thinking

Guided by our principles of value generation, continuous innovation, customer-centricity, and vested collaboration, Blue Water Thinking proudly supports our Federal clients in achieving their Agency goals.

Founded by a decorated twenty-eight year Veteran of the United States Army, Blue Water Thinking understands and supports the mission of our Nation's war fighters, Veterans, their families and caretakers.

Leveraging our executive team's military experience and private and public sector consulting expertise, Blue Water Thinking takes an integrated "one-team" approach and brings to bear best-fit solutions, thought leadership, and grit to meet our client's transformational needs.

Fueled by our values of integrity, respect, professionalism, stewardship and customer service, the Blue Water Thinking team understands the power of the human connection, collaboration, humility and loyalty to one another, our clients and industry partners.

Lastly, our formula for success is simple: Build something good, take care of our people, keep our clients satisfied, nurture our work ethic and reputation, build long-lasting partnerships, enjoy what we do and give back as much as possible.

Job Description:
Blue Water Thinking is seeking an experienced and dedicated Senior Data Analyst to join our team, supporting the Integrated Healthcare Transformation (IHT) initiative at the Department of Veterans Affairs. The primary responsibility of this role is to obtain and analyze data through advanced computerized models and algorithms to inform strategic decision-making and optimize business outcomes.
Responsibilities:

• Extrapolate data patterns using advanced algorithms to identify actionable insights.

• Develop graphs, charts, and visualizations to communicate complex mathematical findings.

• Present analytical outcomes to managers and stakeholders to guide business model adjustments and future planning.

• Apply in-depth knowledge of VHA systems and files, including CDW, VistA, VSSC, RAMP, PTF (MedSAS), MCA, PCMM, NPCD, and VETSNET.

• Collect, clean, and validate large datasets from multiple VA sources.

• Translate raw data into meaningful reports that support healthcare transformation goals.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align data strategies with program objectives.

• Support predictive modeling and trend analysis to improve veteran healthcare delivery.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in Data Science, Statistics, Health Informatics, or a related field.

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a healthcare or federal environment.

• Proficiency in statistical software and programming languages (e.g., Python, R, SAS).

• Strong experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik.

• Demonstrated ability to interpret complex datasets and communicate findings to non-technical audiences.

• Familiarity with VHA systems and data repositories, including CDW and VistA.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Public Health, or related discipline.

• Experience supporting federal healthcare programs, especially within the Department of Veterans Affairs.

• Knowledge of healthcare data standards and compliance frameworks (e.g., HIPAA, HITECH).

• Experience with machine learning models and predictive analytics in healthcare settings.

• Active Public Trust clearance.

• Familiarity of Senator Elizabeth Dole Act Sections 105 and 107

Eligibility:

• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

• Must be able to obtain and maintain the required federal public trust clearance for this role

title: Senior Safety Systems Engineer

ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry - we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

 

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Systems Safety Engineer to support Focused Energy's Austin facility as we advance the TTE project, laser project, and the transition toward operational readiness. This role is designed as an embedded engineering safety position rather than a standalone site-wide H&S management role. The Senior Systems Safety Engineer will work directly with engineering and operations teams to identify hazards, evaluate system risks, and develop practical mitigation strategies during system design, installation, validation, commissioning, and operation.

This role will partner closely with the central safety function, including safety system leadership defined in Germany, while providing strong local technical ownership for engineering safety execution in Austin. The position is especially well suited to a growing, technically complex site where risk must be assessed continuously as systems evolve.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design-for-Safety Integration: Review system designs, changes, and experimental setups to ensure safety considerations are incorporated early and practically. Support engineering teams in translating hazard findings into design requirements, interlocks, procedures, and operational controls.

- Installation and Commissioning Support: Provide hands-on safety support during equipment installation, facility modifications, subsystem integration, validation, and commissioning activities. Ensure hazards are identified and controlled before work is performed and before systems are released for operation.

- Operational Readiness: Support the development of safe operating envelopes, startup/shutdown strategies, lockout-tagout boundaries, access controls, permits, and readiness reviews for new and modified systems.

- Risk Mitigation Implementation: Work with engineers, technicians, and operations personnel to define and track corrective actions, engineering controls, administrative controls, and procedural safeguards to closure.

You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. PROČ JE TAHLE ROLE ZAJÍMAVÁ

- Od nuly: Dostaneš šanci rozjíždět nový projekt na zelené louce a zanechat na fungování nového distribučního centra svůj přímý otisk.

- Reálný dopad: Budeš mít přímý vliv na výkon směny, efektivitu provozu i spokojenost svého týmu.

- Akční prostředí: Nečeká tě stereotypní kancelářská práce - budeš přímo v centru dění moderní e-commerce logistiky.

- Datově řízený provoz: Provoz řídíme na základě dat v reálném čase, takže budeš pracovat s moderními systémy a chytrými nástroji.

- Prostor věci měnit: Dostaneš samostatnost aktivně upravovat a zefektivňovat procesy tam, kde uvidíš příležitost ke zlepšení.

CO TĚ U NÁS ČEKÁ

- Vedení týmu: Budeš vést, motivovat a rozvíjet tým na směně, plánovat kapacity, rozdělovat práci a budovat týmovou spolupráci.

- Odpovědnost za výkon: Budeš řídit směnu podle klíčových ukazatelů (KPI) a zodpovídat za plnění plánovaných cílů.

- Práce s daty: Budeš sledovat provozní čísla v reálném čase, vyhodnocovat výkon a včas reagovat na odchylky.

- Optimalizace procesů: Budeš hledat úzká místa v provozu a aktivně navrhovat i zavádět zlepšení.

- Spolupráce napříč skladem: Budeš úzce spolupracovat s ostatními vedoucími, aby celý tok zboží fungoval plynule.

- Směnný provoz: Pracovat budeš v režimu krátký/dlouhý týden na 12hodinových denních a nočních směnách.

CO OD TEBE OČEKÁVÁME

- Zkušenost s vedením lidí: Máš prokazatelnou praxi s vedením, řízením a motivací týmu v dynamickém prostředí.

- Angličtinu pro běžnou pracovní komunikaci a řešení každodenních operativních situací.

- Analytické a IT základy: Umíš pracovat s daty, běžně používáš PC a rychle se zorientuješ v interních logistických systémech.

- Samostatnost a odpovědnost: Umíš se rozhodnout, převzít odpovědnost a dotahovat věci do konce.

- Chuť rozvíjet sebe i svůj tým a fungovat v prostředí, kde se věci rychle mění.

- Zkušenost ze skladu, logistiky nebo výroby je výhodou, ne však absolutní podmínkou - klíčový je pro nás tvůj lídrovský přístup.

CO TI ZA TVOU SKVĚLOU PRÁCI NABÍDNEME?

description:
Join the ASI Partners family as a legacy person you can come back to or refer others to as a government career source and interview for a direct-hire REMOTE opportunity with a major subcontractor on a long-term contract (potential to 2029) serving a massive IT modernization effort at the Internal Revenue Service (IRS).

We are looking for a fully-certified Salesforce Quality Assurance guru with at least 7 years ideally doing QA with the government Cloud working on Salesforce/Mulesoft, Agile CI/CD, Security model, Apex, LWC, etc.

Having a Public Trust clearance, a SECRET level government clearance, or having a higher-level clearance would expedite your start date on the contract, but we will also consider strong candidates interested in government service that can stay in place for 4-8 weeks while the clearance process finalizes. WE CAN ONLY ACCEPT U.S. CITIZENS and will verify personal information after the initial interview was successful to move forward.

So, what is the major modernization effort?

Older modernization roadmaps lacked long-term retirement strategies for core mainframes so IRS leadership rolled out a new technical framework stretching through 2029 with heavy emphasis on building a Unified API Layer to unlock legacy data. The IRS plans to wrap up its move toward a single, unified Enterprise Case Management (ECM) system. This platform will consolidate siloed databases and allow employees to support taxpayers from a single interface.

Fiscal Year 2028 Target : This is the projected completion window for updating the critical Individual Master File (IMF). The IMF has processed individual taxpayer data since 1970 using outdated COBOL and Assembly Language Code. The IRS aims to fully convert this core code into modern, developer-friendly Java.

By establishing a solid data structure and robust DevOps pipeline (using tools like SFDX and Git), the subcontractor we are hiring for helps create the stable infrastructure required for the IRS Office of Chief Counsel, the Taxpayer Advocate Service, and the Office of Appeals to safely adopt these modern AI systems.

The company is stable, growing, and has been around for 20 years.

title: Software Engineer, Memory & Search
locationText: New York City, NY; New York City, NY | Seattle +5 more
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is looking for Software Engineers to join the Memory & Search team. We own how Claude remembers you and how it finds what it needs, across Claude.ai, Cowork and Claude Code. That spans the user-facing experience (what Claude remembers, how people see and edit it, how search surfaces the right conversation) and the shared infrastructure underneath it, the memory service, indexing, retrieval and vector search.

Memory is one of the biggest levers on whether Claude feels like it knows you. We recently moved memory from a periodically synthesized summary to a dynamic, editable, on-demand system, and then unified it so the same memory follows you across products. Search went from a top user complaint to something people rely on to find past work. The platform is now in place, and the next phase is finding the product form factors that make memory the most compelling and sticky part of using Claude.

That is why we are hiring product engineers. The team is strong on infrastructure, and we want people who have shipped user-facing products at scale, have a sharp sense for what makes a product feel good, and have built agentic systems where the model, the tools and the user interface have to work together. You will run short, demo-driven experiments on top of the memory and search stack, decide what to keep based on real usage, and help the whole team think like a product team. If you have founded a company, been an early engineer at a startup, or taken a product from zero to one, you will recognize the way we want to work.

This is a trust-sensitive surface. Memory touches privacy, consent and enterprise controls, so you will work closely with product, design, privacy, legal and safeguards, and you will be expected to treat those constraints as part of good product design rather than obstacles to it.

Key responsibilities

• Design, build and ship memory and search experiences in Claude.ai, Cowork and Claude Code, owning them end to end from the backend service through the model's tools to the user interface

• Run product experiments on the memory and search stack: form a hypothesis, build a demo, put it in front of real users, measure, and make a clear persevere-or-pivot call

• Shape how Claude uses memory and retrieval inside its agentic loop, including what the model stores, when it searches, how results are ranked and presented, and how the user stays in control

• Define and track the metrics that tell us whether memory is actually making Claude more useful, and build the evaluations that keep quality honest as the system evolves

• Improve search relevance and recall across conversations and memories, working across embeddings, hybrid retrieval and ranking as well as the interface that presents results

• Partner with product, design, privacy, legal and safeguards to ship features that respect user consent and enterprise requirements such as customer-managed encryption keys and data retention policies

• Raise the bar on product quality for the team through design reviews, code reviews and the standards you set for latency, polish and reliability
Share the on-call for the systems you own

Minimum qualifications

• Experience building and operating user-facing products used by a large number of people, including the backend services behind them

• Experience building agentic systems or LLM-powered products, including tool use, retrieval and prompt or context design

• Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across backend services and web front ends

• A track record of taking a product or feature from an idea to launch, and iterating on

description:
WHAT WE'RE RESEARCHING

We're running a paid study on go-to-market strategies tailored to independent retail operations. Specifically, we are evaluating a new appointment management tool designed for independent bicycle repair shops. This research helps us refine our initial product positioning and identify hidden risks before launch.

HOW IT WORKS

You will complete an asynchronous, remote review of a short go-to-market brief. During this task, you will read through our target audience assumptions, proposed messaging, and launch plan. Next, you will write a short report that clearly separates unsubstantiated assumptions from hard evidence. Finally, you will recommend one low-cost validation step to test our riskiest assumption without conducting new market outreach.

WHO THIS IS FOR

We welcome Product Marketing Managers, GTM Strategists, and early-stage Product Managers with experience in retail software or small business tools. Candidates should have a strong grasp of market validation techniques and startup strategy. Familiarity with independent bike shops or local service businesses is a strong plus, though not strictly required.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Read and evaluate a short go-to-market strategy brief for a bike shop appointment tool

- Identify and separate unproven assumptions from backed evidence within the document

- Write a concise written report summarizing your strategic findings

- Propose one cheap, actionable validation step to test the core strategy

WHO SHOULD APPLY

- Professional experience in product marketing, go-to-market strategy, or product management

- Ability to communicate strategic feedback clearly in a written format
